//: Origins of the five independent ReliefMesh sites. 'active' names the profile currently written into the published files (.hocon, agent-manifest.json, bridge callers, partner registry). Switch with: npm run origins:set -- <profile>

local-strict.//: Command on a different loopback host name than its partners, so the runtime's loopback key cookie never reaches a partner server. Bridge frames then get partitioned storage, exactly as on public-suffix hosts.

production.//: Replace with the HTTPS origins of your five deployments, then run: npm run origins:set -- production
